about: The cover contract (docs/baseline/COVER_SPEC.md, D80): the settings `StyleSheet.front_matter.cover` in the stylesheet payload, the cover choices (`cover` of the stylesheet payload), the stylesheet PUT bodies for the cover and their per-key errors, the image upload `api:book_images`, the book page's cover `api:cover`, the new book page URLs and the export page's cover rows (the print option, readiness, notes). Every file holds real answers of the books the tests build and is compared with them (`editor/tests.py::test_cover_payloads_equal_the_contract`, `publishing/test_cover.py::test_export_rows_equal_the_contract`). Normalised: the 24-hex cover hash is `<hash>`, the 64-hex image sha256 is `<sha256>`, image ids are 801 (book 80's portrait photo, 1004 × 1417 JPEG), 802 (book 80's landscape PNG with transparency, 1200 × 800) and 803 (book 81's image); `NASSAKH_WRITE_CONTRACT_FIXTURES=1` rewrites the files. The first version was written from the spec before the code. The top-level keys of each file are descriptive labels, not URLs to call: read the files at test time and do not copy their values into the UI code.

scenario.book 80: «كتاب الغلاف», trim 17×24 (170 × 240 mm), bottom margin 22 mm (so `bottom_mm_auto` = 30), heading face Amiri, book details: title «الأمالي», subtitle «مجالس في الأدب», author «أبو علي القالي», publisher «دار المدار», city «طرابلس», year «2026»
scenario.book 81: another book (its image 803 cannot be used by book 80)
scenario.users: an editor (every change) and a reader (reads only: 403 on every change)

files.stylesheet.json: GET `api:stylesheet`: `stylesheet.front_matter.cover` (always present, the defaults filled in; mode `none` for a book without a cover key), the new `limits` keys and the `cover` choices block (modes, fits, presets with names and colours, defaults, limits, the automatic bottom distance, the upload limits, the print-size note with its pixel numbers for the current trim and for every trim preset, the current image)
files.stylesheet_requests.json: PUT `api:stylesheet` (PATCH is accepted too, the same subset semantics) with `front_matter.cover` bodies: each mode, a fit, texts, a preset, a hand-picked colour, disabling, removing the image; and the refusals (400 `{detail, errors}` with per-key errors `front_matter.cover.<key>`, 403 reader). Only the cover parts of the answers are shown (`stylesheet.front_matter.cover`, `cover.image`); the rest of the answer is the usual stylesheet payload + `preview`
files.upload.json: POST `api:book_images` (multipart `file`, `purpose`): the answers (201 new, 200 the same image again) and the refusals (413 too large, 422 not an image / type not allowed / too many pixels, 400 no file or an unknown purpose, 403 reader, 404 unknown book)
files.cover_api.json: GET `api:cover` in each mode: none; info; image without an image; image (each fit); text
files.page_config.json: the book page's config: the new URLs (`urls.cover`, `urls.bookImages`)
files.exports.json: the export page (`api:exports` GET): the print form's `cover` option (with a cover, without one), the history's words for it, the readiness row `cover_image_missing`, the notes row `cover_resolution` per format

rules.settings: `front_matter.cover` = {mode, image, fit, center, bottom, center_pt, bottom_pt, background, color, preset, bottom_mm}. mode ∈ none | info | image | text (default none); image: a BookImage id of this book or null; fit ∈ fill | width | height (default fill); center / bottom: 0–600 characters, lines kept (each line's spaces collapsed, empty lines at the ends dropped, CRLF → LF); center_pt / bottom_pt 8–96 (defaults 28 and 13; the subtitle and the author of `info` are 0.55 × center_pt); background / color `#rrggbb` (lower case); preset ∈ white | cream | gray | navy | green | burgundy | custom; bottom_mm 0–80 or null (null: the page's bottom margin + 8 mm, `cover.bottom_mm_auto`)
rules.saving: PUT any subset of the keys under `front_matter.cover` (other keys stay). A `preset` sets both colours; a `background` or `color` in the same body wins; `preset` is then recomputed: the preset whose two colours are the page's, else `custom`. Mode `none` keeps the other settings (turning the cover back on restores them). `image: null` removes the image (the file is kept). Errors are per key, `front_matter.cover.<key>`, like `front_matter.fields.<name>`; a body whose `cover` is not an object gets `front_matter.cover`
rules.pages: the cover never changes the interior's pages: a PUT that changes only `front_matter.cover` keeps the preview hash and the live layout (no re-layout, no new book render); the book page refreshes `api:cover` instead
rules.print size: the pixels of the trim at 300 dpi: round(mm / 25.4 × 300) per side (`cover.print_sizes` has the presets; a custom trim uses the formula); the note is «للطباعة: 300 نقطة في البوصة، أي <w> × <h> بكسل على هذا القطع»
rules.cover api: `GET /api/books/<id>/cover/` (login) → {mode, hash, image_1x, image_2x, width, height}: the cover rendered alone (one page, the trim, no margins) and rasterised to WebP, 1× 1100 px tall (`width`/`height` are the 1× pixels) and 2× 2200 px; null images (and null hash / sizes) for `none` and for `image` without an image. Rendered in the request when missing (under a second), cached by hash under media/books/<id>/cover/<hash>/, the newest 3 kept
rules.upload: `POST /api/books/<id>/images/` (editors and admins): multipart `file` (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 30 MB and 12000 px a side) and `purpose` (cover | body, default cover). The image is checked (Pillow verify, then load), turned upright (EXIF), converted to sRGB (CMYK, palette, ICC profiles) and stored normalised as JPEG q92 (opaque) or PNG (with transparency), named by the sha256 of the stored file; `thumb_url` is a WebP at most 480 px long. The same image again answers 200 with the existing row. Files are never deleted when the cover changes
